title: Observation
description: What the model sees of the target window. In p0 this is the trimmed accessibility tree; screenshots are p1 (SPEC-05).

Observation.description: One look at the target window.

app.description: The app's name as the user sees it, for example Keynote.

focused.description: The element number with keyboard focus, read from kAXFocusedUIElementAttribute (AXFocusedUIElement). Absent when the focused element is not in the tree. The harness refuses a type action when this element is a secureTextField (SPEC-05 r7).

layer.description: What is in front in the target window: the window itself, or a sheet, dialog, or open menu over it. That is where the model should act next (SPEC-05 r15).

elements.description: Visible, actionable elements only, numbered from 1, at most 200 (SPEC-05 r2).

windowFrame.description: p1 vision fallback: the target window's frame when this observation was taken, so the harness can check it has not moved or resized before a vision click (SPEC-05 r13).

Frame.description: A rectangle in global screen points, the origin at the top-left of the main display and y growing down (the Quartz and Accessibility convention; negative x or y on a display left of or above the main one).

TreeElement.description: One element of the trimmed accessibility tree.

value.description: Current text or state. Never present for secure text fields (SPEC-05 r7).

Layer.description: The front layer of the target window. defaultButton and cancelButton come from kAXDefaultButtonAttribute and kAXCancelButtonAttribute (AXDefaultButton, AXCancelButton) and are absent when the layer has none or the button is not in the tree.

title.description: The layer's title. Often absent: a sheet usually has no AXTitle on macOS.

defaultButton.description: The element number of the default button, the one Return presses.

cancelButton.description: The element number of the cancel button, the one Escape presses.

LayerKind.description: window: nothing covers the window. sheet: an AXSheet (kAXSheetRole) attached to the window. dialog: a window with subrole AXDialog or AXSystemDialog (kAXDialogSubrole, kAXSystemDialogSubrole). An alert is reported as the sheet or dialog it is shown in: macOS has no alert role or subrole in AXRoleConstants.h. menu: an open AXMenu (kAXMenuRole).
